translations.web: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”
translations.bsb: Anything the unclean person touches will become unclean, and anyone who touches it will be unclean until evening.”
translations.kjv: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.
translations.asv: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.
